subject: Coverage upload guidance and PO/EDI integration for new vendor
messages:
From: Contracts Team <contracts@cloudhaven.io>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha.patel@cloudhaven.io>
Date: Tue, 15 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coverage and PO details for Redwood POC

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. Attached are our current COI and subcontractor list for the Proof-of-Concept (files attached below). We're ready to map to your PO/EDI flow once you confirm the billing party and partner ID.

Attachments: cloudhaven_coi_20280815.pdf (certificate, general liability/cyber), cloudhaven_subcontractors.xlsx, cloudhaven_w9.pdf

A few asks from our side:
- Please confirm the PO number format and whether you support EDI 850.
- Are there any required endorsement wordings beyond Additional Insured?
- Where should we upload the finalized COI (portal vs SFTP)?

Happy to sign a conditional PO if you need immediate coverage while we finalize an endorsement.

Best,
Asha Patel
Contracts Manager
CloudHaven Solutions
asha.patel@cloudhaven.io
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Contracts Team <contracts@cloudhaven.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage and PO details for Redwood POC

Asha — thanks for the COI and quick turnaround. A couple of requests to help procurement move forward:

1) Coverage specifics we need on the COI:
   - General Liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
   - Professional/Technology E&O: $1,000,000
   - Cyber/Privacy Liability: $1,000,000
   - Waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference (where applicable)

2) Endorsements:
   - Please add Redwood Inference as Additional Insured with CG 20 10 (or equivalent) for General Liability.
   - If subcontractors are used (see attached), ensure they are covered or listed.

3) Certificate holder details for the COI:
   Redwood Inference
   201 Mission St, Suite 600
   San Francisco, CA 94105

4) Upload method: we prefer the vendor portal for auditability. If the portal is not available for your account yet, secure SFTP is acceptable — please confirm host and whether you need an account created.

5) PO/EDI: procurement will need your remit-to address and EDI partner ID to map invoices to the PO automatically. If you can provide a contact for billing systems, that helps.

I'll loop Marissa and Jonas here to confirm process and timeline; procurement can issue a conditional PO if endorsements are pending.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Partner Ops
Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Contracts Team <contracts@cloudhaven.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Aug 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage and PO details for Redwood POC

Hi Asha — quick note from procurement: welcome, excited to work with CloudHaven. A few process items so you know what to expect.

- PO timing: once COI + required endorsements are uploaded and verified, standard PO issuance is ~5 business days. We can issue a conditional (time-limited) PO within 48 hours if you flag it as needed.
- EDI: Redwood uses EDI 850 for PO intake; our partner ID for mapping is RH-EDI-4779. Please include that in the EDI ISA/GS headers. If you cannot EDI, we accept CSV invoice uploads to the portal (template attached).
- Billing / remit-to: CloudHaven should invoice to:
   Redwood Inference
   Accounts Payable
   ap@redwood.com
   201 Mission St, Suite 600
   San Francisco, CA 94105

- Invoice format: PDF attachment + matching CSV (fields: PO#, invoice#, line#, qty, unit price, tax, total). See po_template.csv attached.
- Tax / W9: we require a W9 for US entities (already included in initial attachments) — thanks.

If the COI lacks the endorsement language, send confirmation and we'll accept a conditional PO for onboarding activities up to $10k while you obtain the endorsement. Final PO will be issued upon verification.

Marissa Cole
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@cloudhaven.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Aug 2028 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage and PO details for Redwood POC

Thanks Rafael / Marissa — appreciate the details. Quick update: we will

- Upload an endorsed COI to your vendor portal by end of day tomorrow (we confirmed Additional Insured language and Waiver of Subrogation with our broker).
- Send a signed subcontractor declaration (cloudhaven_subcontractors.xlsx updated) and the W9 (cloudhaven_w9.pdf) to the portal too.

Portal vs SFTP: we can do either. For speed, we'll upload to the portal link you shared (https://redwood.app/drive/Shared/CloudHaven/COI-20280815). If the portal user account isn't provisioned, we'll send SFTP credentials privately — host: sftp.cloudhaven.io (we will not include credentials in this thread).

EDI: we will aim to send an EDI 850 test tomorrow referencing RH-EDI-4779. Billing contact is Kim Rivera (kim.rivera@cloudhaven.io).

DocuSign envelope for the endorsement amendment will be sent to Rafael for signature (DocuSign envelope ID: 0ab9-ef11).

Thanks — will confirm once uploads are complete.

Best,
Asha Patel
Contracts Manager
CloudHaven Solutions
